## Global flags

Usage: `fcctl [-h] [--profile PROFILE] [-s SERVER] [-o {table,json,yaml,ndjson}] [--wait [SECS]] [--no-wait] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--dry-run] [--debug] [--no-color] [--yes] [--confirm [TARGET]] [--max-retries N] [--no-progress] [--version] COMMAND ...`

| Flag | Metavar | Choices | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--profile` | `PROFILE` |  |  | profile name (else FCCTL_PROFILE or `profile use`) |
| `-s, --server` | `SERVER` |  |  | Frappe Cloud server id (server-xxxx) |
| `-o, --output` | `OUTPUT` | `table, json, yaml, ndjson` |  | output format (non-TTY default: json) |
| `--wait` | `SECS` |  |  | wait for tasks (default); `--wait 0` = no wait, `--wait N` = wait up to N seconds |
| `--no-wait` |  |  |  | return after submit |
| `--timeout` | `TIMEOUT` |  |  | wait timeout in seconds (default 1800 for server/snapshot, 3600 for tasks); exit 8 on timeout |
| `--dry-run` |  |  |  | show what a write would do |
| `--debug` |  |  |  | show tracebacks |
| `--no-color` |  |  |  | disable colored output |
| `--yes` |  |  |  | skip prompts (never bypasses guard/policy) |
| `--confirm` | `TARGET` |  |  | confirm a guarded write (echo the target) |
| `--max-retries` | `N` |  |  | retries on 429/5xx/network errors for idempotent requests (default 3, env FCCTL_MAX_RETRIES; 0 disables) |
| `--no-progress` |  |  |  | no progress on stderr |
| `--version` |  |  |  | show program's version number and exit |

Examples:

```
fcctl profile list
fcctl --dry-run site drop demo.example.com
fcctl -o table site list
Run `fcctl COMMAND --help` for a command's options and examples.
```

Usage: `fcctl app [-h] COMMAND ...`

```

## fcctl app add

Usage: `fcctl app add [-h] [--repo REPO] [--branch BRANCH] [--sites [SITES ...]] [--site SITE] [name]`

| Flag | Metavar | Choices | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` |  |  |  |  |
| `--repo` | `REPO` |  |  |  |
| `--branch` | `BRANCH` |  |  |  |
| `--sites` | `SITES` |  |  |  |
| `--site` | `SITE` |  |  | fetch and install NAME on this site (repeatable) instead of only adding it to the bench |

Examples:

```

## fcctl approval approve
